recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, slightly desaturated monochrome photograph of a man sitting in a vintage convertible car, set against a dark, textured ground. The top third of the composition features bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography arranged in a horizontal block.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright, metallic car body acts as a massive visual anchor against the dark void of the ground.
The man's casual posture in the driver's seat creates a focal point within the geometric lines of the car.
The vibrant, multi-colored text at the top provides a modern, energetic counterpoint to the classic, desaturated image below.
coreInvariants: High-angle 'bird's eye' perspective on the vehicle.
Extreme contrast between the bright car and the dark, textured asphalt or grass.
Strict horizontal alignment of the header text block.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly diagonally from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white/silver hood and interior of the convertible.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the colorful text at the top, move down to the man's face, and then follow the length of the car toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top third of the image is a dark, textured field that serves as a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated silver and deep charcoal/black in the photographic element.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary artist name and secondary quartet text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky blue, lime green, and muted red used for specific words in the title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; high saturation contrast in the typography against the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Square-ish proportions with slightly rounded corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century grotesque forms.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space above the subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-coding to differentiate hierarchy and mood.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century American grotesque aesthetic and weight.
Provides the necessary impact and tight structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle, monochrome photo of a man in a 1960s convertible car parked on dark asphalt. The car is bright silver/white, creating high contrast. The top 30% of the image is dark, empty space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, all-caps sans-serif text in the top dark area. The first line should be a mix of white and three distinct colors (blue, green, red) for different words. The second line should be smaller and white, centered under the first part of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the text all-caps and bold?
Are there at least four colors used in the typography?
Is the car the primary visual anchor?

adjustableVariables: Car color (though white/silver provides best contrast)
Specific accent colors in the text
Texture of the ground (grass vs. asphalt)

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space at the top

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the man's face is clear but not the sole focus.
Verify the desaturated, vintage film look of the photo.
Confirm the typography does not overlap the car.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-angle monochrome subject + Dark top-third negative space + Multi-colored bold sans-serif header.
